Install the Obsidian Sheet Plus plugin ​

To install the Obsidian Sheet Plus plugin:

  1. Open Obsidian.

  2. Navigate to Settings > Community Plugins.

  3. Search for Sheet Plus.

  4. Click Install, then Enable.
